description: A VideoAnalyzer Agent that autonomously processes and acts on data inputs using video recognition tools to interpret content, identify objects/actions/patterns; combined with web browsers for real-time internet retrieval—enabling surveillance, content moderation, automated tagging, insight extraction from streams, and correlation with online resources in dynamic workflows.

tools.name: VideoRecognitionAPI
tools.description: An API that processes video input to recognize and interpret visual content.

tools.name: ObjectDetectionTool
tools.description: A tool that identifies and classifies objects within video frames.

tools.name: ActionRecognitionTool
tools.description: A tool that detects and interprets actions occurring within video content.

tools.name: PatternRecognitionTool
tools.description: A tool that analyzes video streams for recurring patterns and behaviors.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: A tool that retrieves real-time information from the internet to support decision-making.

tools.name: DataAnalysisTool
tools.description: A tool that processes and analyzes data extracted from video and web sources.

tools.name: ContentModerationAPI
tools.description: An API that ensures video content adheres to community guidelines and standards.

tools.name: AutomatedTaggingSystem
tools.description: A system that automatically tags video content based on recognized objects and actions.

tools.name: InsightExtractionTool
tools.description: A tool that extracts meaningful insights from analyzed video content and related data.

tools.name: RealTimeStreamingAPI
tools.description: An API that allows the agent to process and analyze live video streams.
